name: TiltedCard-TS-TW
title: Tilted Card
description: Two tall photos in rounded frames that tilt in 3D toward the cursor and lift slightly, with a small white caption tag that follows the pointer and a brief mobile warning.
use: You want a photo, poster or album cover to feel physical and interactive on a portfolio or gallery page.
avoid: It is built for desktop pointers and shows a warning on mobile; the tilt and caption do nothing on touch or keyboard.
a11y: Tilt and caption follow only the pointer; there is no keyboard equivalent and no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two tall, narrow photos with rounded corners stacked down the centre of a dark stage: a pastel mountain sunset above and a starry night sky below. Each image sits in its own frame with a faint mirrored reflection at its base, and a small white caption tag can float over the photo.
behaves: Moving the pointer over a photo rotates it in 3D toward the cursor and scales it up slightly; a white caption tag follows the pointer and rocks with its vertical speed. Leaving springs the card back flat and hides the tag.
customise: Props set the image source, alt text, caption, container and image sizes, hover scale, tilt amount, whether the tooltip and mobile warning show, and overlay content. Styling is fixed in the source.
weight: light: One or two images with spring-driven transforms; no loop runs while the pointer is idle.
demo: A mountain sunset captioned 'Mountains · Unsplash' and a starry night captioned 'Starry Night · Unsplash'.
issues: Tilt and caption need a mouse; nothing happens on touch or keyboard.
On small screens the caption is hidden and a plain warning tells users to switch to desktop.
polishWhy: Two nice photos with a smooth tilt, but the effect is standard and mobile gets only a warning.
